name: flame.skill-learning/archive.v2
description: Return an optional absolute activity cutoff for the supplied observation time. The caller alone admits and commits archival.

name: flame.skill-learning/mine.v2
description: Mine a completed Run using bounded collaborators. Commit an admitted proposal and its original mining receipt in the same transaction.

name: flame.skills/approve.v1
description: Record a human decision for the current proposal and retain its original publication permit.

name: flame.skills/capture.v1
description: Record an interaction's original Skill source choices for exact receipt recovery.

name: flame.skills/confirm.v1
description: Close the original publication after the authorized filesystem owner confirms publication or a definite precondition conflict.

name: flame.skills/discover.v1
description: Select among the host-admitted Skill readers for a human catalog.

name: flame.skills/propose.v1
description: Stage a reviewed library draft under its immutable originating command.

name: flame.skills/reject.v1
description: Withdraw an exact pending proposal before approval.

name: flame.skills/reviews.v1
description: List outstanding proposal commands in the admitted libraries, including publications awaiting confirmation.
